text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...If both of them run, it'll be explosive.
Like
fireworks.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fireworks I can't set off alone. Fireworks
so
striking and dramatic that everyone
will look up
and watch.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And then, just when the time is ripe, I'll
take the
stage—a stage set for the
biggest and most
glorious production.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In other words, we should make my next
race the
Fillies' Revue.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's been a few days since the Hanshin
Juvenile
Fillies, and I'm still not sure how
to interpret her
words that day.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan isn't really one to ask for
approval
or provide explanations to
begin with.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I didn't think she'd leave me—her
trainer and
partner during the Twinkle
Series—in the dark as
well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
How could it be, when she's
complimented my
work ethic? The only
conclusion I can draw is that
this
distance must be normal to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After all, each Umamusume has a
different
relationship with her trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Feeling somewhat isolated, I decide to
take a
stroll around the academy to lift
my spirits.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Wow! This article is fascinating...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Tehe.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see Aston Machan reading a magazine,
and she
seems to be deliberately making
a show of it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, what are you reading, Machan? An

interesting feature?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Scarlet! Hehe, exactly. Check out this
page right
here!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Where? This one? Hm...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: "Whether it's at the Classic Triple Crown or the Triple Tiara tour, next year's star is sure to be Vodka!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"She attracted astonishing levels of
attention in
the Hanshin J.F., and now,
as the number one
newcomer to watch,
she's rapidly on the rise!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ..."Number one."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
She's amazing, isn't she? And I'm sure
next year
she'll be even more amazing.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Scarlet?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Um, I'm sorry. It's nothing! ...I just

remembered I have something to do!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: See you, Machan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daiwa Scarlet suddenly takes off. As she
hurries
away, Aston Machan watches
until she's out of
sight.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Number one"? Out of all the rookie
racers?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm going to win! Me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Nobody else! ME!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh! I can't stand it! I'm going to
explode!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm number one! ...I'm number one!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Nnngh! One more lap!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hey, Scarlet!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The lights are out. What if you trip and
fall?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Geez. If Machan hadn't said anything, I
might not
have even seen you there.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Machan?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That doesn't matter right now. What's
goin' on
with you? You've been all over
the place lately.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine. Everyone goes through rough
patches.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Still. You're hardly ever around, you're
not eating
right, and even in class, you
look like something's
bugging you the
whole time.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...
None of that's true.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's all true. What's wrong? What
happened?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Well?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: IT'S OBVIOUSLY YOUR FAULT!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh? What did I do?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You're Vodka. "The number one
newcomer to
watch"!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I mean, it's no surprise. Your
performance at the
Hanshin Juvenile
Fillies took everyone's breath
away!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I had to remind myself to breathe too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
But no more! I'm not letting you take
anything
else away from me!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I'm going to be number one!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh, this is the worst!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The dark track falls quiet. And then,
after the
silence...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: I'm enterin' the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...What?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I spent so long trying to figure out what I
should
do next. But now I know!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna take you on in the Oka Sho.
And I'm
gonna use our battle to launch
myself to even
greater heights!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Cause that's how I can be the very
coolest!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
If you don't like it, go ahead and try to
beat me.
Bein' number one's your thing,
right?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ngh... You're such a pain!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Stop trying to act cool! I'm going to
thrash you in
the Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Did you hear?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Apparently, Vodka's going to enter the
Oka Sho.
She's entering the preliminary
race, too—the
Tulip Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan said this might happen
after the
Hanshin Juvenile Fillies.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She predicted Vodka would enter the
Tulip Sho
too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For a mere hunch, I seem to remember
her
sounding fairly sure about it all...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Everyone's in place.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The Tulip Sho comes first. The flames
will be
burning bright, with the cherry
blossoms in full
bloom. It'll be a dazzling
stage.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
And Machan will come in to sweep the
win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan gazes out the window,
smiling as
softly as always.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And from that day on, as though a
switch has
been flipped, she applies
herself to her training
much more
seriously.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Rrraaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Huff... Pant!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I have to keep going! ...One more lap!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Rrraaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan's intense training pays
off, leaving
her honed and ready for the
Oka Sho.
